Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-22T02:27Z · #35901: an `objectExtensions` entry declares where its own fields, groups and child lists go (`place` with `after` / `before`). The placement is applied once, in objectql's `foldExtendersOntoDefinition` after every contributor's fields are merged, in (priority, package name) order. The record page, the form and Studio read that one result. Item 4 (an extension arranges only its own items) is refused at parse, at `defineStack` and at merge. Uninstalling or disabling drops the contributor and invalidates the cache; the original object is never written.
Area: b1-RS (epic #35896); prerequisites #35923 (8df7bf23) and #35925 merged.
Session: `session_01L6bhgUxeTKkCvZ2iariHQf` (card thread)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-g0rke3 (one PR, `Fixes #35901`)
File surface: `packages/spec` `ObjectExtensionSchema` (`place`) · objectql `registry-object-registration.ts` (`foldExtendersOntoDefinition`) · `os validate` hints · the browser `deriveRelatedLists` (an unplaced other-package child list stays, the flip ruled in 7072511859) · Studio read-only source badge · tests, changeset, migration entry, ADR-0146 D10 + ADR-0085 notes.
Container & model: `L`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: xhigh`
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Premise (PR body's top lines): holds, with two forks. F1: where a child list goes when the parent declares no `relatedLists`, which is true of every object today. F2: where a group goes when the parent declares no `fieldGroups`. Both are with a fable review, then go to the maintainer as a decision card. The thread builds the recommended arm (a) meanwhile: placement applies only where the parent declares the list, otherwise today's automatic order is kept and nothing is dropped, with a hint in the log and in `os validate`. A different ruling is applied before the PR is finalised.
Small calls (thread, listed in the PR body): the order of several items after one anchor; materialising a group's members when a field is inserted into a group without `fields`; "end of tabs" = before trailing `sys_approval_request` / `sys_activity`; package-less children keep #35923's rule; the parent's own placement of an extension list wins.
Reviews: L1-c; contract L2 at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (fable) by the seat; Tier H expected (ADR notes), so the hand-off goes to os-zhuang. `Skills-docs: follow-up #35902`.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; possible plain conflicts with #36147 / #36149 / #36151 in record-page rendering only.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-22T02:36Z · #35901, two forks from the thread's premise, reviewed by fable first, then put to the maintainer on two decision cards.

1. F1 + F2, a parent that declares no `relatedLists` / no `fieldGroups`: 「父对象声明了才生效」. `place` (`after` / `before`, and a list entry's `label` / `columns`) applies only where the parent declares the tab list or groups. Otherwise the extension's child lists and fields keep today's automatic order at the end, nothing is dropped, and the startup log and `os validate` say the placement did not apply. No new served or protocol key.
2. A child list another package adds, with no `place` entry, on a parent that declares `relatedLists`: 「装了就自动排在末尾」. It appears at the end of the declared tabs (before trailing `sys_approval_request` / `sys_activity`). This delivers the maintainer's earlier 「先隐藏,#35901 再解决」 (7072511859) and flips #35923's shipped "hidden until named" for other-package lists. The PR's changeset and migration entry state the flip.

Follow-on for #35902: HotCRM uses `objectExtensions` today (o2c, psa, revenue), and none of its 38 objects declares `relatedLists`. Placement has no visible effect in HotCRM until its core objects declare tab lists and those modules add `place`.
